decisions.briefing: Markets were flat and neutral today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Top candidates like FIGR, CRCL, QXO and SOFI show strong momentum (RSI, MACD, price-above-SMA20) but lack the volume-surge confirmation that past lessons flag as needed for high-conviction entries on a quiet day, so we're holding our 7 existing positions and keeping cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the S&P 500 up a modest 0.3% and the NASDAQ up just 0.1%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any major catalyst. Without a strong directional move, momentum traders are seeing fewer high-conviction setups, as reflected in the screened candidate list where top names show bullish technicals but no volume confirmation. This kind of low-volatility, range-bound session often precedes a bigger move once a clear catalyst (earnings, Fed commentary, economic data) emerges.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤表現平淡，標普500指數僅小幅上漲0.3%，納指更只升0.1%，顯示投資者在觀望，未對任何重大消息作出明顯反應。由於缺乏明確方向，動能交易者較難找到高確信度的進場機會——篩選名單中雖有多隻股票技術指標偏多（如RSI、MACD），但普遍缺乏成交量放大的確認訊號。這種低波動、區間徘徊的交易日，往往是在重大催化劑（如業績、聯儲局言論或經濟數據）出現前的醞釀期。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Patience in investing means resisting the urge to put cash to work just because it's sitting idle — even when you have room for more positions. On a neutral day with no strong confirming signals (like a volume surge alongside bullish momentum), waiting for a clearer setup protects you from chasing weak trades.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 投資中的「耐性」是指不因現金閒置就急於進場，即使投資組合仍有空位。在市場方向不明、缺乏強力確認訊號（例如成交量放大配合升勢）的日子裡，耐心等待更清晰的進場機會，能避免追逐訊號不足的交易。
